scope: UNSCORED local durable planner exchange around unchanged reviewed controller; no scheduler/provider activation
criteria: Pending planner request survives clean process exit and restart without a held principal lease or pre-created Turn.
Canonical packet, protocol, full model input, state identity and adapter/controller code hashes bind each immutable durable request.
Launch identity is recorded once. Missing output after recorded dispatch stays pending/uncertain; never automatic re-launch. This does not prove exactly-once external launch.

Response matches request/input/launch identifiers; same raw bytes redeliver idempotently; changed bytes or identifiers, duplicate JSON keys, malformed encoding, non-finite values and stale head reject before worker work.
Fresh process consumes durable response through unchanged admission/start/verification. Principal receipts reconcile interrupted adapter acknowledgments; completed work is not replayed.
Concurrent ticks/deliveries and restart at request, response and verification boundaries do not duplicate worker work.
Crash after start remains ambiguous and uses existing fenced expiry/recovery to BLOCK without replay; no automatic claim that the worker never ran.
Changed adapter/protocol/controller or damaged stored input/output is detected before a tick mutates principal state.
Six-wake amended repair sequence and completion sleep remain intact in local mechanics tests; failures are evidence-true and never forced verdicts.

Bounded fresh task-model integration uses existing authorized no-history task launches only, fixed schema wrapper+current packet, unchanged outputs, no retries/steering. This remains manually orchestrated, not unattended scheduling.
Independent reviewer checks exact final code/evidence before publication; original artifacts, repositories and website branches remain preserved.
nonclaims: No agent-inaccessible trust boundary, MAC seal, owner-hidden fault, k>=8 repair discrimination, full transcript/input isolation, unattended scheduler, company/scored acceptance or production readiness.
A recorded dispatch receipt is a local assertion, not provider attestation. The safe recovery for unknown external launch outcome needs provider reconciliation or owner review.
Existing 35 tests/31 probes and prior five-model six-opportunity result remain historical evidence; any new deterministic tests prove adapter mechanics only.
